title: arbiter.json — one verdict per disputed finding (review-arbiter). Input: ONE finding + ONE dispute + the cited rules; nothing else.

verdict.description: UPHOLD = reviewer is right, writer must fix. OVERTURN = writer is right, finding closed. ESCALATE = the answer changes observable behaviour or touches a D-1 category — the owner decides. Any verdict that would change spec/contract MUST be ESCALATE.

rule_applied.description: the rule_ref that decided it (AC / convention / constitution / contract)

escalation.description: required when verdict = ESCALATE; becomes a decision entry for the owner
